Embedded output exports one constructor per command into the configured
package: the command's dependency roots plus a composed cleanup, with
no CLI tree, signal handling, or process exit. The host owns lifecycle.
-- go.mod --
module app

go 1.26

require github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli v0.1.0

replace github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli => CLIDIR
-- fabrik.yaml --
generate:
  emit: embedded
  dir: appwire
-- shared/db.go --
package shared

type DB struct{}

//fabrik:provider name=db
func NewDB() (*DB, func() error, error) { return &DB{}, nil, nil }
-- shared/report.go --
package shared

type Report struct{}

//fabrik:provider
//fabrik:inject db name=db
func NewReport(db *DB) (*Report, error) { return &Report{}, nil }
-- shared/cli.go --

	var cleanup1 func() error
	unwind := func(err error) error {
		if cleanup1 != nil {
			err = errors.Join(err, cleanup1())
		}
		return err

}

func buildDb() (*shared.DB, *shared.Report, func() error, error) {
	var sharedDBDbClose func() error
	cleanup := func() error {
		var errs []error
		if sharedDBDbClose != nil {
			errs = append(errs, sharedDBDbClose())
		}
		return errors.Join(errs...)
	}
	unwind := func(err error) error {
		return errors.Join(err, cleanup())
	}
	sharedDBDb, sharedDBDbClose, err := shared.NewDB()

		return nil, nil, nil, unwind(err)
